summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Westport Fuel Systems Inc., a foreign private issuer, furnishing its management information circular and proxy materials for its 2026 Annual General and Special Meeting, which includes routine items such as director elections, auditor appointment, advisory vote on compensation, and a name-change proposal. No abrupt or forced CEO/CFO/board departure is disclosed; the filing is a standard proxy solicitation. Under a conservative approach, this does not qualify as a special situation. Category is 'None' because the event is a routine meeting notice, not a management change event.
